🕵️ Generative AI

Generative adversarial network (GAN)

In simple words

Two neural networks trained against each other: one makes fakes, the other tries to catch them, and both get better.

An idea from 2014 for generating images: two neural networks compete. The generator makes fake images; the discriminator tries to tell them from real ones. Each improves by beating the other, until the fakes look real. GANs led image generation for several years, before diffusion models took over.

Example. Think of a forger and a detective: every time the detective spots a fake, the forger learns to make better ones, and the detective learns to look closer.

Related words

  • Generative AIAI that creates new text, images, music, video or code from patterns it has learned.
  • Diffusion modelAn image generator that learns to remove noise step by step, turning random speckles into a picture that matches a prompt.
  • DeepfakeA fake video, image or voice recording made with AI that shows someone saying or doing something they never did.
